source.note: Baselines are observed search data, not traffic forecasts. Start each 28-day evaluation window on the first complete day after production release.

strategy: Build a 365-day transportation traffic engine without disturbing the pending Mackinac Bridge flagship conditions treatment.

experiments.hypothesis: Leading the snippet, H1 and direct answer with the observed toll-cost query language — 2026, $4 one way and $8 round trip — will convert existing page-one impressions better than the earlier generic fare/calculator treatment.

latestLeadingSignal.purpose: Treatment refinement and prioritization only; the original pre-release baseline remains the experiment baseline.

how much is the toll to cross the mackinac bridge
how much is the toll for the mackinac bridge

treatment.title: Mackinac Bridge Toll Cost 2026: $4 Car Fare & Calculator
treatment.metaDescription: Mackinac Bridge toll 2026: $4 one way for a standard car, $8 round trip. Calculate RV, trailer and motorhome costs from official axle rates.
treatment.h1: Mackinac Bridge Toll Cost: 2026 Fares & Calculator
treatment.firstAnswer: The Mackinac Bridge toll is $4 one way, or $8 round trip, for a standard two-axle passenger car in 2026.

experiments.stopCondition: Official Mackinac Bridge Authority fare changes, calculator formula regresses, canonical changes, or average position falls materially below page one.

experiments.hypothesis: Pairing official wait-time intent with the truthful live approach-camera intent already earning clicks will lift overall CTR while preserving the page's border-wait utility.
experiments.truthBoundary: The Gordie Howe operator currently says its own live camera feeds are coming soon. The page must label the displayed Ontario 511 image as a live approach camera, never as an operator bridge camera.
experiments.stopCondition: Official wait-time retrieval regresses, the Ontario 511 camera fails persistently, operator camera availability changes without the copy being updated, or the canonical changes.
